_doc: SoT of the html site repos this hub mounts as submodules (owner-declared). .gitmodules and the gitlinks are derived from it: node scripts/gen-gitmodules.mjs [--check]. Each repo is mounted at a root folder of the same name; the two base entries keep their historical folders. All Projects-* html repos are listed (Projects-___ is the Projects hub, mounted per repo under 0_hub, so it is not repeated here).
